title: Custom hooks, data fetching, React Query

preview.what: Custom hooks and data fetching, including React Query-style caching.
preview.picture: A custom hook is a reusable recipe card; React Query is a pantry that remembers what you fetched and when it goes stale.
preview.why: Shows you can structure a real React app, not just components.
preview.bn: Custom hook = reusable রেসিপি কার্ড; React Query = pantry যা মনে রাখে কী আনা হয়েছে, কখন পুরনো হবে।
